used.construction: bar(isoform) = 2 * mean_over_arms( se(arm, isoform) ), where se is the standard error of the 25-fold paired difference of that arm against `plain`, pooled across notebook 37's ten arms. Pooling across arms is the point: it estimates how well a 25-fold paired comparison on this partition can resolve ANY difference, independently of the one being tested.
used.explicitly_not: 2 x the SE of the comparison under test (circular)
